name: Relightable 3D Gaussian
definition: A method assigning per-Gaussian BRDF parameters (albedo, roughness, normal) and precomputed visibility for shadows.
summary: Relightable 3D Gaussian Splatting enables dynamic relighting and shadow casting by assigning per-Gaussian BRDF parameters and precomputed visibility, distinguishing itself from standard splatting by evaluating material responses to arbitrary light sources.
